Fixed in src/dotenv/parser.py only.

Diagnosis: `_equal_sign = r"(=[^\S\r\n]*)"` consumes `=` plus trailing whitespace, so for `KEY= # explanation` the reader lands on `#` and `parse_value` fell through to `parse_unquoted_value`, whose `re.sub(r"\s+#.*", "", part)` found no whitespace before `#` (already consumed) and returned `"# explanation"`.

Change plan (implemented):
1. `parse_binding` captures the `_equal_sign` match and passes `preceded_by_whitespace=len(equal_sign) > 1` to `parse_value`.
2. `parse_value` gains that flag; when the next char is `#` and whitespace preceded it, returns `""` (inline comment). Otherwise `#` stays literal (`KEY=#literal`, `KEY=a#b`).
3. Quoting, exports, and ordinary comments are untouched; the default flag preserves all other call paths.

No tests/docs/other modules/deps modified. Host should run the test suite to confirm.
